name: Kawakami Sousuke
source:
A first-year student and a member of the Art Club.
He is good friends with Sugita and is often seen with him.
He gives off a consistently gentle impression, though he also has a shy side.
Thanks to his androgynous appearance, he is quite popular among his male peers.
